name: Summary Disclosure
job: Keep the whole plan one line tall until the reader asks for it: a title and a one-line summary when closed, the fact tiles and a quiet note when open.

anatomy.role: Chevron, title (headline size, 600), one-line exec summary; at least 52px tall; wraps under the title on phones
One bordered box; a hairline under the summary when open
Optional quiet box under the tiles, 0.9rem

states.name: Closed
states.note: The default above the fold: title plus the one-line summary.

states.name: Open
states.note: Chevron turns 90 degrees; tiles then the note.

use_when: Above the fold, so the high-level plan is one tap away without taking the screen.
The closed line should be enough for an executive: title plus one sentence.
avoid_when: Do not nest disclosures inside it, or hide the reader's next action inside it.
Do not repeat the summary line as the first tile.

data.note: One sentence, shown closed and open.
One or two sentences in the quiet box.

access: Native `details`/`summary`: keyboard, screen-reader state and no-script all work without code.
The chevron is `aria-hidden`; the summary has a 2px cyan focus ring.

used_by.name: Approved My Ally Step 1 template (public/myally-hub.html, PR 2094)

gates: `kit_specimen.py --check` (in scripts): this page matches its spec.
`kit_primitive_sync.py --check` (in scripts): every page that marks this block carries it unchanged.
Reading-options check: 375 and 1280, light and dark, largest text size, roomy spacing and the easy-read font.
